name: jmp-textmate
description: Syntax highlighting for jMouse access-policy documents.

textMateRules._comment: declare | assign say what KIND of statement follows — structure, or a case. They are not blocks; they qualify one. So they deliberately do NOT get a colour of their own: whatever hue the theme gives a keyword, plus italic and bold. A reader scanning the left margin should be able to tell a prefix from the block it labels without reading the word, and a second colour would have made the label look like a thing.
